recognize_zh: 低倍免疫組織化學染色：骨髓腔幾乎全被呈棕色膜狀陽性的細胞瀰漫填滿，右側骨小樑染成藍色；在此病例中陽性標記最可能為 B 細胞標記（如 CD20），顯示淋巴瘤瀰漫性浸潤骨髓，但圖上未標示抗體名稱。
features: Diffuse, strong brown membranous/cytoplasmic immunoreactivity in the majority of marrow cells
Marrow spaces packed with positive cells in a diffuse (not nodular or interstitial) pattern
Bony trabecula with blue counterstain on the right
Near absence of negative background hematopoietic cells and fat
Antibody not specified; low magnification limits cytologic assessment
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow core biopsy shows diffuse, strong membranous staining in sheets of cells that fill the intertrabecular marrow spaces, with only rare negative cells and scant residual fat. The pattern of involvement is diffuse rather than nodular or paratrabecular. The antibody is not labeled on the image; in the context of this case, the staining most likely represents a pan-B-cell marker such as CD20 or PAX5. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: B-cell infiltrates are characteristically paratrabecular and CD10/BCL2-positive with small cleaved cells, rather than diffuse large cells.
Can be diffuse CD20-positive but cells are small, CD5/CD23/LEF1-positive with weak CD20.
Diffuse PAX5/CD79a-positive infiltrate but cells are TdT and often CD34 positive with dim or absent CD20.
Diffuse infiltrate is CD138-positive and CD20-negative in most cases.
